fields.statement: QA at 071ed6b8, binary built with go build into a scratch dir, run in a fresh git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN/ACTOR unset. rhiza note add store '...' wrote one entry (node note-store plus a link) and exited 0; note add <change set id> wrote a note and exited 0; note add <change set id> --op <its node.create op> exited 0; note add nonesuch exited 2 with 'no node or change set "nonesuch"'; --op 01ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ exited 2 with 'is not an operation of change set'; render then rhiza check printed ok (exit 0). make check exit 0.

QA at 071ed6b8, binary built with go build into a scratch dir, run in a fresh git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN/ACTOR unset. change show --json listed a node.create of kind note with its body in fields.statement and a link of type discusses from the note to the capability; a note on a change set with --op carried op in change show --json; apply of a discusses link from capability store to a note exited 2 with 'link type "discusses" does not go from capability to note'; rhiza guide lists note among the kinds; describe --json documents discusses; rhiza check clean. make check exit 0.

QA at 071ed6b8, binary built with go build into a scratch dir, run in a fresh git repo with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN/ACTOR unset. After two notes on capability store and two on the change set (one with --op), rhiza show store printed a Notes section with 'Is the log append-only?' then 'Second thought.', each as '- <id> by darin-haener at 2026-11-02T11:22:..Z: <text>'; show store --json had node.notes with actor, at, id, text in that order. rhiza change show printed both change-set notes in order, the second marked '(on op 01M6DZXGM8GHA7)'; change show --json notes carried actor, at, id, op, text.
